title: От частей к общему списку
setup:
CREATE VIEW v_persons_female AS SELECT * FROM person WHERE gender = 'female';
CREATE VIEW v_persons_male AS SELECT * FROM person WHERE gender = 'male';

positive.why: UNION ALL: имена не повторяются, результат тот же
positive.sql: SELECT name FROM v_persons_female UNION ALL SELECT name FROM v_persons_male ORDER BY name;

negative.sql: SELECT name FROM v_persons_female ORDER BY name;
SELECT name FROM v_persons_female UNION SELECT name FROM v_persons_male ORDER BY name DESC;

negative.why: обращение напрямую к таблице вместо представлений (запрещено по смыслу)
negative.sql: SELECT name FROM person ORDER BY name;
SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('Andrey'), ('Anna')) AS t(name) ORDER BY name;
